title: Type of Residence
previewText: Semi-detached or attached single-family residences in R2 Districts and attached single- or two-family residences in R3-1 Districts may be permitted by special permit of the City Planning Commission in accordance with the provisions of Section 107-74 (Modification of Permitted Use Regulations). Such residences shall comply with the minimum lot area and lot width requirements as set forth in the table in Section 107-42
